title: Unregistered Combinational Loop in READY Logic
description: AWREADY is driven by a combinational path that includes AWREADY itself as an input, creating a zero-delay combinational loop that causes simulation oscillation.
bug_signature: VCS-ERROR: Combinational loop detected involving net 'awready'
expected_root_cause: The READY generation logic creates a feedback path: `awready = !busy && awready` — a self-referential combinational expression [18].
failure_log:
Elaboration error: combinational loop. Simulation delta-cycle oscillation.
VCS-ERROR: awready undefined.
success_log: awready updated on posedge clk only — no loop.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) if (!rst_n) awready <= 0; else awready <= !busy;
